from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingStart(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly housing start value reported in a document, used to resolve conflicts by release date."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The data month in YYYY-MM format (e.g., '2022-08')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The not seasonally adjusted housing starts in thousands of units")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The document release date in YYYY-MM-DD format to determine precedence")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_starts_data: list[MonthlyHousingStart]
